fusions.name: Clap in the Rafters
fusions.desc: Cracks the lash overhead with a report that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles and stuns each for 1 second.

fusions.name: Nightfeeder's Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks the tip into the first enemy it meets, which deals 4 damage, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Belfry Swing
fusions.desc: Lashes a spot up to 7 tiles away and hauls you to it at once. You also gain 10% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Echo Off the Walls
fusions.desc: When you strike with your weapon, a bolt hits the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 6 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
